import.title: Bulk import
import.description: Upload a CSV or Excel file to add many products at once.
import.formatDescription: The first row must have these column headers: name, description, price, currency, stock, image, product_url, category, sku, variants. Only name is required — leave the rest blank if you don't have that info.
import.formatPriceHint: If you set a price, also set its currency (e.g. BRL, USD, EUR) — a price without one will be skipped.
import.formatVariantsHint: variants is optional — if used, it must be a JSON object mapping each option to its values, e.g. '{"Color": ["Blue", "Red"], "Size": ["S", "M", "L"]}'.
